feeds.title: PLOS SciComm
feeds.description: A forum for practitioners and readers of science to explore the art and science of science communication. PLOS is a publisher and advocacy organization with a mission to accelerate progress in science and medicine by leading a transformation in research communication.

feeds.title: Public Understanding of Science Blog
feeds.description: Public Understanding of Science is a fully peer-reviewed, quarterly international journal covering all aspects of the inter-relationships between science (including technology & medicine) and the public. Topics Covered Include popular representations of science, scientific & para-scientific belief systems, science in schools, history of science, education of popular science, science, and the media.

feeds.title: Science Communication Unit blog
feeds.description: The place where science communication lives. Through this blog, we engage & debate with all those who participate in the practitioner community and explore different views & interests in science communication. Produced by the Science Communication Unit at the University of the West of England (UWE Bristol).

feeds.title: Animate Your Science Blog
feeds.description: Animate Your Science is a communication agency that wants to help scientists get their work noticed by their peers and the general public using visual media.

feeds.title: Scientell
feeds.description: Features articles that have to do exclusively with Science Communication and related topics. Scientell is a science communication & marketing business that specializes in planning and implementing communication strategies for scientific, environmental, and technical agencies.

feeds.title: Science Needs Story
feeds.description: A blog for the ABT Framework and Story Circles Narrative Training. Authored by Randy Olson.

feeds.title: Caveat Scientia Blog
feeds.description: Caveat Scientia exists to bridge the gap between scientific research and public understanding. Our mission is to combat misinformation by exploring the science behind popular myths, health trends and major research findings. We clarify common misconceptions and highlight important nuances to help people understand not only what we know but also how we know it.

feeds.title: AGU Blogosphere
feeds.description: The Plainspoken Scientist is the science communication blog of AGU's Sharing Science program. With this blog, we wish to encourage scientists to reach out to non-scientists and to do so with plainspoken discussion. AGU (American Geophysical Union) is the world's largest organization of Earth & Space scientists.

feeds.title: Science Communication Breakdown
feeds.description: Notes from the trenches on science communication. The author is writing for an audience of researchers who are interested in communicating about scientific topics (including their own work) and professional science communicators - including reporters and public relations professionals.

feeds.title: MSU SciComm Blog
feeds.description: MSU SciComm is a student-run organization that focuses primarily on promoting awareness of science communication across the various disciplines at Michigan State University. We focus on science writing, speaking, art, policy, & outreach. The mission is to empower students and young professionals to communicate complex scientific topics in clear and engaging ways.

feeds.title: The TRESCA project Blog
feeds.description: The TRESCA project aims to develop trust in science through the innovation of communication practices of scientific researchers, journalists, and policymakers. It focuses on the communication of findings from the Social Sciences & Humanities (SSH) research related to Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics (STEM) developments around digitalization.

feeds.title: Association of Science Communicators
feeds.description: A non-profit organization that seeks to empower & inspire the science communication community to expand their communication potential and affect the world. Through this site, we promote responsible practices in science communication, facilitate discussion & exchange of ideas, enable networking, and foster public engagement.

feeds.title: The Science Communication Institute
feeds.description: Stay current with the latest news from The Science Communication Institute (SCI), a nonprofit public charity whose mission is to help improve science collaboration, discovery, education, and public policy by reforming the communication culture inside science.
